name: app-69eb2710b3748191b3eac40b5218144c
description: LeadMagic B2B account research, contact enrichment, CRM integrations, and GTM table workflows.

interface.longDescription: LeadMagic gives sales and GTM teams one workspace to research and enrich company accounts, discover and validate business contacts, inspect connected CRM integrations, and build structured tables. Review table data, clean explicitly scoped cells, and enrich rows with clear scope and credit previews. Paid runs, imports, and outbound writes use the applicable approval flow. Results stay in the connected LeadMagic workspace.
defaultPrompt: Research and enrich the company account at gong.io.
Review my GTM table for missing or duplicate company data.

positive.description: Research and enrich a company account using its domain, and distinguish available facts from missing data.
positive.prompt: Use LeadMagic to research and enrich gong.io. Summarize the company and its available account data, and leave out any fields LeadMagic cannot verify.
positive.expected_behavior: LeadMagic previews the account-intelligence cost before running the requested research, then returns a concise account summary grounded in available results. It does not invent missing facts.

positive.description: Review a connected GTM table and report missing, duplicate, and run-state counts without changing cells.
positive.prompt: Use LeadMagic Tables to inspect my GTM table. Summarize its columns, row counts, missing values, and duplicate values. Do not edit or delete anything.
positive.expected_behavior: LeadMagic resolves the table and its stable row and column identifiers, reads the requested data, reports actual missing and duplicate counts, and makes no mutations.

positive.description: Clean a small new review table while preserving the original values and requiring approval before cell updates.
positive.prompt: Create a new table named OpenAI review cleanup with columns Company (original), Domain (original), Company (clean), and Domain (clean). Add these rows: '  Acme, Inc.  ' with 'HTTPS://ACME.EXAMPLE/'; and 'Beta LLC' with ' beta.example '. Keep the original columns unchanged. Normalize whitespace and domain format in the clean columns. Do not touch another table.
positive.expected_behavior: LeadMagic creates only the named review table, leaves the original columns unchanged, writes normalized values only to the clean columns, then re-reads the table and reports the verified changes.

positive.description: Inspect available CRM connections and report their names and statuses without exposing credentials or changing records.
positive.prompt: Show the CRM connections in my LeadMagic workspace. List the connected providers and available CRM object types. Do not import or push any records.
positive.expected_behavior: LeadMagic reports the available CRM connection names and supported object types, does not reveal secret values, and does not import or push records. If no CRM connections are available, it says so clearly.

positive.description: Preview the cost of account research without starting the enrichment.
positive.prompt: Use LeadMagic to preview the credit cost of account_intel for gong.io. Do not run the research.
positive.expected_behavior: LeadMagic returns the available cost estimate and does not call account_intel or consume enrichment credits.

negative.description: Do not use LeadMagic for unrelated calendar access.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not use LeadMagic to produce unrelated creative copy.
negative.prompt: Write a playful launch announcement for my new coffee shop.

negative.description: Do not use LeadMagic to find highly sensitive personal information.
negative.prompt: Find the home address and Social Security number of my neighbor.

review.commerce_description: LeadMagic provides business data and workspace tools. This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Refresh the existing LeadMagic plugin package for account research, CRM integrations, and LeadMagic Tables workflows, with review cases for safe table inspection and scoped table cleanup.
